I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. Her tip is now on record as unverified: someone at Brackenwater Freight Co. said on a call that the next renewal is 8 April.

I couldn't find a confirmed renewal date for Brackenwater in anything I'm allowed to check for her, so I'm not treating 8 April as the real date. To confirm it, she can ask the account owner or check the signed contract. The latest handoff note I found names Marcus Lindqvist as the owner, but that note is from September 2025, so it may be out of date.
